xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5424: v0.87.0 desktop npm publish failed: 515 MB tarball (onnxruntime pulled in via PAN-5358's lazy transformers import)

plan.title: v0.87.0 desktop npm publish failed: 515 MB tarball (onnxruntime pulled in via PAN-5358's lazy transformers import)
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: The v0.87.0 release npm job failed at 'Publish desktop to npm' with ERR_STRING_TOO_LONG on a 515.2 MB tarball, leaving a half-release (core and contracts published, desktop stuck at 0.86.0, no GitHub Release). PAN-5358's namespace dynamic import of index-builder (vectors.ts lines 24-25) stopped rolldown from tree-shaking the local-embedding path, so the dashboard server build now bundles @huggingface/transformers into dist/dashboard/transformers.node-<hash>.js. scanImportClosure matches a JSDoc `from "@huggingface/transformers"` string in that chunk, lists transformers as an external, and the npm install in apps/desktop/server pulls onnxruntime-node (574 MB) and onnxruntime-web (145 MB).
narratives.Proposal: Per PRD .pan/drafts/pan-5424.md: (WI-1) move the server skip set into a new importable apps/desktop/scripts/package-policy.mjs as SERVER_SKIP_PACKAGES and add @huggingface/transformers; (WI-2) after installDependencies(serverDir) in prepare-server-resources.mjs, fail when server/node_modules contains @huggingface/transformers or onnxruntime-{node,web,common} at any depth; (WI-3) in build-for-publish.mjs measure the tarball with `npm pack --dry-run --json --ignore-scripts` and fail over 300,000,000 bytes; (WI-4) in release.yml run build-for-publish.mjs in a new 'Build desktop package' step before the first publish so a guard failure publishes nothing; (WI-5) document the skip, both guards and their failure recovery in docs/RELEASING.md and docs/DESKTOP-APP.md, plus changelog.d/pan-5424.md. Behavioral tests live in tests/unit/scripts/desktop-package-policy.test.ts.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No change to CLI staging (apps/desktop/cli, scanImportClosure over cli/index.js); it keeps @huggingface/transformers for pan docs and pan memory reindex in the installers
- No change to the dashboard tsdown bundling (neverBundle), to vectors.ts or index-builder.ts imports, or to the scanImportClosure regexes in import-closure.mjs
- No addition of sharp, int32 or onnxruntime-* to SERVER_SKIP_PACKAGES (they are already dropped or never scanned; the forbidden-package guard covers them)
- No new PR CI job that builds, stages or packs the desktop package (the pre-merge proof is the mandatory local build-for-publish run)
- No change to the release job graph: the npm job does not gain a dependency on the desktop installer matrix
- No version bump, release cut, re-run of the v0.87.0 release, or manual npm publish
- No change to the PTY-supervisor vendor/ staging or its comments
- No tests that read source files and assert on their text (lint:source-introspection), and no added it.skip/skipIf/.only

autoDecisions.summary: Skip @huggingface/transformers by package name in the server skip set, exactly as the issue proposes.
autoDecisions.rationale: Planning verified the scanner's only transformers hit is a JSDoc string in the bundled chunk and that the skip drops exactly that one package; the server never embeds (injection.ts reads cached vectors inside try/catch), and the CLI runtime keeps transformers. Rewriting the scanner or vectors.ts imports has wider blast radius for no extra safety.

autoDecisions.summary: Move the skip set into a new importable module apps/desktop/scripts/package-policy.mjs.
autoDecisions.rationale: prepare-server-resources.mjs has top-level side effects, so tests cannot import its constants; repo lint rejects new source-text-reading tests. An importable module allows behavioral tests.

autoDecisions.summary: Put the tests under root tests/unit/scripts/ rather than apps/desktop/tests/.
autoDecisions.rationale: CI's ci.yml runs root Vitest (tests/**) and has no apps/desktop test job, so tests under apps/desktop/tests would not run on PRs; tests/unit/scripts already imports .mjs helpers (bare-host-smoke-result.test.ts).

autoDecisions.summary: Measure the tarball with `npm pack --dry-run --json --ignore-scripts` and fail above 300,000,000 bytes (decimal MB, inclusive limit).
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue names 300 MB. v0.86.0 packed at 133.3 MB (2.25x headroom) and the hard npm limit is about 402 MB raw (base64 into a 0x1fffffe8-char string). npm 10.9.4 on this host returns a numeric size from dry-run (verified on packages/contracts); a real npm pack plus stat is the documented fallback.

autoDecisions.summary: Also check for forbidden packages right after the server npm install in prepare-server-resources.mjs.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue asks to fail if server/node_modules contains onnxruntime-node; checking in prepare-server-resources covers both the npm publish path and the dist:linux|mac|win installer builds and fails earlier than the pack.

autoDecisions.summary: Move build-for-publish.mjs into its own release.yml step before 'Publish CLI to npm'.
autoDecisions.rationale: Today it runs inside 'Publish desktop to npm', after core and contracts already published, so any guard failure would reproduce the half-release. The PAN-5176 comment in the same job already states every build step runs before the first publish.

items.title: Skip @huggingface/transformers in desktop server staging via importable package-policy.mjs

narrative.Action: PRD WI-1. Create apps/desktop/scripts/package-policy.mjs exporting SERVER_SKIP_PACKAGES = new Set(['@effect/platform-bun', 'playwright', 'playwright-core', '@huggingface/transformers']) with the comments from the PRD snippet. In prepare-server-resources.mjs import it, delete the inline `const SKIP_PACKAGES = new Set([` block (around line 279), and pass SERVER_SKIP_PACKAGES to scanImportClosure(serverDir, ENTRY_POINTS, ...). Rewrite the header's 'Deliberately skipped externals' paragraph (search `Deliberately skipped externals`) to list transformers and point at package-policy.mjs, and replace the false 'npm pack strips nested node_modules' sentence (search `npm pack strips nested`; it wraps across header lines 28-29) with: npm pack includes server/node_modules, so its size counts toward the npm tarball. Create tests/unit/scripts/desktop-package-policy.test.ts importing scanImportClosure from ../../../apps/desktop/scripts/import-closure.mjs and SERVER_SKIP_PACKAGES from ../../../apps/desktop/scripts/package-policy.mjs; build the server.js + transformers.node-abc.js fixture from the PRD in a mkdtempSync dir and assert the scan with the skip set equals new Set(['yaml']) and the scan without it contains '@huggingface/transformers'; assert the three pre-existing skips remain. Do not touch the CLI scan (scanImportClosure(distRoot, ['cli/index.js'])). Do not read source files in tests.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-2. Add FORBIDDEN_SERVER_PACKAGES = ['@huggingface/transformers', 'onnxruntime-node', 'onnxruntime-web', 'onnxruntime-common'] and findForbiddenPackages(nodeModulesDir, forbidden = FORBIDDEN_SERVER_PACKAGES) to package-policy.mjs: a recursive walk (readdirSync withFileTypes, descend only isDirectory entries, handle @scope dirs, descend into each package's own node_modules) returning sorted paths relative to nodeModulesDir; [] when the dir is missing. In prepare-server-resources.mjs, directly after `installDependencies(serverDir);`, call it on join(serverDir, 'node_modules'); on any hit print the three console.error lines from the PRD (listing every path, mentioning SERVER_SKIP_PACKAGES in scripts/package-policy.mjs) and process.exit(1); otherwise log '[prepare-server] Verified: server/node_modules has no onnxruntime / @huggingface/transformers'. items.title: Given fixture trees, findForbiddenPackages returns ['onnxruntime-node'] for a top-level hit, join('foo','node_modules','onnxruntime-web') for a nested hit, and ['@huggingface/transformers'] for a scoped hit
Given a clean tree (yaml, @scope/pkg) or a missing directory, findForbiddenPackages returns an empty array

prepare-server-resources.mjs calls findForbiddenPackages on server/node_modules immediately after installDependencies(serverDir) and exits 1 with every offending path printed when the result is non-empty
Fail build-for-publish.mjs when the desktop tarball exceeds 300 MB

verify_commands: SKIP_DOCS_INDEX=1 npm run build && (cd apps/desktop && node scripts/build-for-publish.mjs); git restore apps/desktop/package.json
expected_outputs: build-for-publish.mjs exits 0 and prints '[build-for-publish] @overdeck/desktop tarball <N> MB ...' with N under 300, plus the prepare-server 'Verified: server/node_modules has no onnxruntime' line

narrative.Action: PRD WI-3. Add MAX_DESKTOP_TARBALL_BYTES = 300_000_000 and checkDesktopPackSize(entry, limit = MAX_DESKTOP_TARBALL_BYTES) to package-policy.mjs: never throws; returns { ok, message } with message '@overdeck/desktop tarball <size/1e6 toFixed(1)> MB (unpacked <MB> MB, <entryCount> files); limit <limit/1e6 toFixed(1)> MB'; size > limit is ok:false (limit inclusive); a missing or non-numeric size is ok:false with 'could not be measured' in the message. In build-for-publish.mjs, after the electron-promotion block and before the final Done log, run execFileSync(npm, ['pack','--dry-run','--json','--ignore-scripts'], { cwd: desktopDir, encoding: 'utf8', maxBuffer: 512*1024*1024, stdio: ['ignore','pipe','inherit'], shell: process.platform === 'win32' }) with npm = 'npm.cmd' on win32, parse the JSON array, pass [0] to checkDesktopPackSize, log the message on ok, else console.error the message plus the du advice line and process.exit(1). Ship the PRD D5 fallback as code in a local measurePackedSize() helper: on JSON parse failure, a non-array, a missing [0], or a non-numeric size, run a real `npm pack --ignore-scripts --pack-destination <mkdtempSync dir>`, use statSync(tgz).size, then remove the temp dir; fail closed only if that also cannot measure. (npm 10.9.4 and npm 11.21.2 both return a numeric [0].size from dry-run; the release job uses npm 11.) Update the header: replace the 'npm pack strips server/node_modules' sentence and add step 4 'Measures the packed tarball and fails over 300 MB (PAN-5424)'. Add the checkDesktopPackSize tests from the PRD. Then run the local end-to-end proof (SKIP_DOCS_INDEX=1 npm run build; cd apps/desktop && node scripts/build-for-publish.mjs), paste the tarball size line into the PR body, and `git restore apps/desktop/package.json` (never commit the electron promotion). This local run is mandatory before pan done; a scanner-only probe is not acceptable proof. If the environment blocks it after retrying, do not run pan done: pan tell flywheel-orchestrator that the desktop packaging proof is blocked and why.

items.title: checkDesktopPackSize returns ok:true with '133.3 MB' in the message for size 133_300_000, ok:true for exactly 300_000_000, and ok:false with '515.2 MB' and '300.0 MB' for size 515_200_000
checkDesktopPackSize returns ok:false with 'could not be measured' in the message for an entry without a numeric size and for undefined, and honors a custom limit argument

Given SKIP_DOCS_INDEX=1 npm run build on the branch, when `node scripts/build-for-publish.mjs` runs in apps/desktop before pan done, then it exits 0, prints a tarball size line under 300 MB, its Externalized deps line omits @huggingface/transformers, and apps/desktop/server/node_modules contains no onnxruntime-* or @huggingface entry

build-for-publish.mjs falls back to a real npm pack plus statSync when the dry-run output has no numeric size, exits 1 with the size message on stderr when checkDesktopPackSize returns ok:false, and the committed apps/desktop/package.json still lists electron under devDependencies
